author: Phantom_ink64
quote: The game is incredibly unique of how much of an improvement it was. While you’re combining the physics and mechanics with Brie for a while and using regular functionality from the original, it’s purely creative. It carries the same formula of the story and enhances  a fantasy world we all imagine in our heads back in the old days to make it very accurate of how unique medieval game it should be.  The music feels so lively the environment and controls feel fluent. Although if the game feels a little bit easier, it’s probably because majority of us have played this game a millions of times, but it does have some sort of challenge behind it because of how the controls functions now and of course the difficulty isn’t too hard nor to easy for the newcomers.

quote:
In GTA history, you’ve always played as an absolute degenerate with no boundaries limitations, no morals or standards and you’ve always gotten away with consequences and it didn’t matter who you offended because it’s just a game. In this game strips away everything because the game is so focused on today society, which ****. The point of games like this is to entertain you to get out of society not to relive what you’re dealing with right now knowing how much real life **** in these times and you need a break from it. GTA VI is a GTA six is an absolute downgrade. You can’t attack a specific person without being worried if they are a gender, a protester, but their race or their sexual orientation. You can’t steal cars or certain things especially in a game like grand THEFT auto. You can’t be too destructive or hazardous in certain environments indoors or outdoors because the game punishes you for it. I haven’t played all the GTA games, but I’m sure some of them have better romantical stories than this… or instead you play us a man that’s barely a criminal or a crime Lord or a mafia, but just some chump that robs gas stations and trying to get back with his baby mama from prison meanwhile she cheats on him…many fans waited for 13 years suffering that was beyond greater than GTA V and this is the result of their patience and that’s not fair What they received. Add to insult of injury this is one of the few games that has more bans in history  and some or more people can’t get their refunds back. If this was the case, it would’ve been better if GTA V would’ve ended,  as the final game of the franchise. I don’t know what and how this game became the way it is, but it’s an absolute dumpster fire. And the fact that not many fans have an opinion about this game, but somehow critics read it on 99 knowing the game is buggy glitchy unfinished, the game itself, and the story is dog water… clearly this game was rigged. The judges were paid to make this game the highest rating of the game rewards. For something that was most hated doesn’t deserve to be in game rewards. I can see this game being just as bad as sonic the hedgehog 2006 and we all know that game didn’t get a lot of love back then unless you were a true sonic fan. And the game itself is just as woke as the live action, Snow White movie, which is worse.  People say this game is targeted towards women when this game doesn’t really feel like a woman’s game not even female gamers that play this even enjoy GTA VI. This is just some woke feminist left slop to piss off a lot of players. 

When the game awards arrive, please make the right decision and accept the truth… that GTA VI ****.
